# Mohammed Waleed — Full Stack Developer

> Mohammed Waleed is a full stack developer from Egypt with 6 years of programming experience and 4 years of freelance delivery.
> He builds scalable web applications and RESTful APIs that blend solid architecture, clean code, and modern technology into products that are reliable and smooth to use.
> Available for freelance projects worldwide.

## Who is Mohammed Waleed?

Mohammed Waleed is a full stack developer based in Egypt. He works across the entire stack — from database design to polished user interfaces — mainly with React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, and MongoDB. He combines frontend and backend development with AI-powered workflows to ship faster and with cleaner code.

He served as Team Lead & Full Stack Developer from March to September 2024, coordinating cross-functional teams of designers and developers, managing agile task distribution, code reviews, client communication, and end-to-end SDLC delivery. He is currently studying while continuing freelance full stack development.

## Services — What Can Mohammed Waleed Do For You?

### 1. Web Application Development
Scalable, production-ready web applications with clean system architecture — from database design to polished, responsive interfaces built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

### 2. Backend Engineering
REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication, third-party integrations, and business logic engineered with Node.js, Express, PHP, Laravel, and TypeScript.

### 3. Large-Scale Platforms
Inventory management, warehouse operations, QR and barcode tracking, and analytics dashboards — large-scale commerce and educational platforms built end-to-end.

## Projects

### Educational Platform
A complete science education platform for chemistry featuring:
- Barcode-based attendance verification at classroom entry
- Automated parent notification system for attendance confirmation
- Real-time internal chat
- Secure video and file upload management
- Advanced content access control with time-based video restriction

### Commerce Platform
A smart commerce, inventory and QR tracking platform featuring:
- Inventory management
- Warehouse operations
- QR and barcode scan-based product verification
- Analytics dashboards

Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and GraphQL.
